q1: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE CUSTOMERS.ID NOT IN( SELECT ORDERS.CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS )
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT NAME AS CUSTOMERS FROM CUSTOMERS WHERE CUSTOMERS.ID NOT IN( SELECT ORDERS.CUSTOMERID FROM ORDERS )
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 are designed to find the names of customers who have not made any orders. They achieve this by checking if the customer ID does not exist in the ORDERS table.
